thread:
OpsBot: Alert: surge in 502s + increased per-token latency in eu1 (gen endpoints). Triage ticket created.
Ana Torres: I'm seeing a spike starting ~09:12 UTC. Error payloads show "model_incompatible_variant" on a subset of requests.
Leo Kim: Checked router logs: recent traffic rule for model family 'redwood-v2' added a variant alias that doesn't support tiled KV format -> causing runtime 502s when routed. Change landed 09:08 UTC.
Grace Nguyen: Rolling back alias change immediately. Command: `redwoodctl routing revert --rule-id=rt-2026-0423-eu1`
EngOncall: Revert in flight on blue pool, canary at eu1-pod-19. Watching errors.
OpsBot: Revert applied to canary at 09:18 UTC. 502s on that pod dropped to near-zero within 30s.
Support: Flagging affected customers for CS outreach. Preparing short message for public status page.
Leo Kim: Also enabling per-customer fallback to nearest compatible variant as interim: `routing.fallback.enabled=true; routing.fallback.priority=compatible_variant`
Grace Nguyen: Throttling concurrent requests to 6 for the affected model family to reduce cascading errors while global rollback completes.
Ana Torres: Post-revert metrics: overall 502 rate down 78%, token latency trending back toward baseline. Two clients still seeing retries; investigating client-side tokenization differences.
EngOncall: Completed full rollback to previous routing config at 09:26 UTC. Full rollout verification green.
Support: Draft public update: "We experienced elevated 502 errors and increased latency in eu-1 due to an incompatible routing alias. We reverted the change and applied fallbacks; service restored for most customers. We're contacting affected accounts directly." Approve?
StatusBot: Incident page created: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1799991111 (internal notes redacted).
Leo Kim: Action items: 1) Add automated validation for variant compatibility in routing CI, 2) add alert for alias-to-variant mismatch, 3) postmortem owner assignment.
Grace Nguyen: Assigned postmortem owner: Leo Kim. ETA initial draft: 48hrs.
OpsBot: Suppressing repeat alerts for eu1 at 09:35 UTC; will reopen if error rate > 0.5% for 5m.
Ana Torres: Final internal status: mitigated, ongoing monitoring for client tokenization edge-cases, CS outreach in progress. Runbook link: https://internal.redwood.ai/runbooks/routing-variant-compatibility
StatusBot: Public message queued: "Resolved — EU region experienced elevated 502s and latency due to a routing configuration that directed traffic to an incompatible variant. We reverted the change and enabled fallbacks; performance restored for the majority of customers. If you continue to experience issues, contact support@redwood.ai." Publishing pending CS approval. :white_check_mark:
